## Validation Evidence

<!-- List exact commands and outcomes. Do not claim validation that was not performed. -->

- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass.
- [ ] GCC build passes with warnings treated as errors.
- [ ] Full CTest suite passes.
- [ ] Clang build passes with warnings treated as errors.

## Contributor Self-Review

- [ ] The branch contains one logical change and excludes unrelated refactors.
- [ ] Public APIs have XML-style documentation and thread-safety contracts where applicable.
- [ ] New source files include the required copyright header.
- [ ] Error paths and compatibility behavior are covered by tests where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation, build files, and tests were updated where needed.
